records.title: State Stream Transformer (SST) V2: Parallel Training of Nonlinear Recurrence for Latent Space Reasoning
records.reason: SST V2 adds per-layer latent state streams and extra forward passes per token; the 27B setup stores about 651 KB of state and uses two-pass parallel training. Co-training Gemma 3 27B on a small GSM8K-derived set reports +15.15 points on GPQA-Diamond vs matched fine-tuning; staged compute reaches 61.11% vs 51.01% at one iteration. Flat extra iterations regress accuracy, native halting is absent, and each iteration adds full-stack FLOPs; it targets reasoning quality, not lower inference cost.
